chatgpt-work.name: ChatGPT Work (cloud browser)

chatgpt-dots.name: ChatGPT dots (always-on agents)
chatgpt-dots.cost: ChatGPT Pro; rolling out gradually to selected Plus users; Business Standard and Premium; eligible Enterprise workspaces (18+, not in the EU/EEA, UK or Switzerland)

claude-cowork.name: Claude Cowork
claude-cowork.cost: Paid Claude plans only (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise)

gemini-spark.name: Tasks in Gemini (formerly Spark)
gemini-spark.cost: Now called Tasks in Gemini: free from Nov 17, 2026 in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India (Gemini 4 Hydrogen); calls, Google Pay purchases and email/text hand-off start in the US

google-universal-cart.name: Google Universal Cart
google-universal-cart.cost: In Google Search and the Gemini app (U.S.)

grok-bot.name: Grok Bot (personal agents)
grok-bot.cost: Included with Premium, Super and Ultra on The X Subscription; or link SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy or X Premium+; a Grok Business seat; or a legacy paid Cursor plan

meta-muse.name: Meta Muse
meta-muse.cost: Free with a usage limit; Power $20/month (500M Muse tokens a week, 10 calls a day) or Maximum $100/month (3B tokens a week, 20 calls a day). 18+ to subscribe.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.cost: Free plan; paid plans add more

n8n.name: n8n
n8n.cost: Free to self-host; paid cloud plans

make.name: Make
make.cost: Free plan; paid plans add more

ollama.name: Ollama (local models)
ollama.cost: Free to download; runs open models on your own computer

notebooklm.name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
notebooklm.cost: Free with a Google account; Google AI plans raise usage limits

home-assistant.name: Home Assistant
home-assistant.cost: Free, open source; runs on a small computer at home

1password-agents.name: 1Password for Agents
1password-agents.cost: No extra cost on 1Password Individual and Family accounts on 1Password.com (not .eu or .ca), per 1Password, Oct 22, 2026; a 1Password subscription is needed

manus-cue.name: Cue by Manus
manus-cue.cost: Invite code required; free during early access per reviewers; an agent phone number is a separate subscription in select countries

riverside-agents.name: Riverside Agents
riverside-agents.cost: Included on all Riverside plans; some tasks use AI credits and the agent asks first

hob.name: Hob
hob.cost: Free and open source (MIT); runs on your own computer

kiwi.name: Kiwi
kiwi.cost: Free during the pilot; you pay for anything it books

openclaw.name: OpenClaw
openclaw.cost: Free and open source; the AI model you connect may cost extra

hermes-agent.name: Hermes Agent
hermes-agent.cost: Free and open source (Nous Research); the AI model you connect may cost extra

ifttt.name: IFTTT.ai
ifttt.cost: Free plan (1,000 credits a month, unlimited Applets); paid plans from $2.09/month billed yearly

walmart-sparky.name: Walmart Sparky
walmart-sparky.cost: Free in the Walmart app and on walmart.com (U.S.); you pay for the groceries

myheritage-gaia.name: MyHeritage GAIA
myheritage-gaia.cost: Free trial allowance for MyHeritage subscribers; more with OmniAI plans

nod.name: Nod (n8n Labs)
nod.cost: Free and open source (research preview); you pay the AI provider you connect

google-ask-maps.name: Ask Maps (Google Maps)
google-ask-maps.cost: Free in the Google Maps app; appointment finding US-only at launch
